newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures recover late, most end higher.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures recover late, most end higher.

text.p: May 28 - IMM currency futures recovered late, most ended higher. Traders tied late bounce back toward midrange to short profittaking after busy spike lower in marks, Swiss franc on news Buba rejected Bonn gold, currency revaluation plan. Bonn said it would stick with plans to revalue Buba reserves. June marks respected support at the $0.5874 area, chartists said.
